notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other creatures
easyPrerequisites: Brigid and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Brigid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

uses.name: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind
